meta.note: Names, descriptions, grades and Gamerscore verified against PSNProfiles and Output Lag (19 Nov 2026); both lists agree on all 55 names. Guides are written in the author's own words and cite their sources. Five trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch and are marked verified:false — their methods are not guessed.

psn.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. It is the last trophy by definition — there is nothing extra to do beyond the roadmap. Work through the three phases in the Roadmap view and this follows.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Reach 100% Completion on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion). The checklist only appears after the story, but everything you did earlier already counts. The Roadmap view lists all 35 checklist items with their exact numbers — 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 39 gang operations, 8 bank vaults and the rest. This is the longest trophy in the game, around 100 hours of the ~200-hour platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Unmissable. Complete the final story mission. Keep an untouched manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so that save is your only way back if you want to revisit the ending.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Do not stop at 250 — the 100% checklist needs 300, so keep stunting past this trophy.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges. The 100% checklist needs all 42 as well, so there is no shortcut — practise each range until every challenge is gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through the optional mission That’s Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone — and escaping with a 4-star Wanted Level also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some questlines count — Andy’s, Billy’s and Tyrone’s have their own trophies and do not count here, so check the counter after each strand you finish. Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) and counts toward this total, so do it the moment it appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; the 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 sets, so this trophy pops early on the way to the full collection.
trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Scan landmarks as you travel — and scan vehicles too, since a scan also counts as discovering the vehicle for Whip It Good. The 100% checklist needs exactly 100 WAiNK scans.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade games, pool, mini golf, basketball, drone races and the gym are the usual set. Just sample each one; you do not need to win or finish anything for this trophy.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The 100% checklist needs 30 of 40 races won, plus 10 of 13 race challenge gold medals, so keep racing well past 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. The easiest way is a bank vault escape — vaults give you 4 stars immediately. It pops only once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob 3 shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and only the red heat zone remains, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning long after this pops.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 map regions. Drive and fly through every corner of the state; the WAiNK app helps you find spots you have not visited yet.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy pops on the way to the full set.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them. The total is cumulative, and the 100% checklist needs the same $250,000 fenced.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Win at least one race at each location; the 100% checklist also needs all 42 Drone Time Trials completed.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, food, anything. It fills up naturally while you buy garages, gear and ammo for the other trophies.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay ‘n’ Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges run through the fishing activity — take the challenge against Cal when it is offered and out-fish him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any arcade machine counts — pick one and play it through to the end. The 100% checklist asks you to play all 4 video games, so this pops while you work on that.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. MISSABLE: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation. After the mission Down to Earth, check the kitchen in the morning — Lucia heads out to the balcony of Jason’s house to meditate. Follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends and there is no mission replay, so keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim (L3 + R3 while aiming). Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Use the Snap Gun on a store’s locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored truck jobs come through the robbery missions — tail or ambush a truck, take it, and escape the heat. Like Hot Together, it pops only once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so keep going past 50 and leave the 10 hardest for last.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.guide: Unmissable. Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first story trophy and the start of the story chain.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Unmissable. Complete Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene. Before you leave Chapter 1, make sure you did Lucia’s balcony meditation — it feeds Positive Mental Attitude and never comes back.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Unmissable. Complete Chapter 2. (PlayStation prints the name censored as shown here; the full name is “Tits Ass Drug Money”.)
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Unmissable. Complete Chapter 3. Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in this chapter — it is time-sensitive and counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Unmissable. Complete Chapter 4. Near the end of this chapter the optional mission That’s Where The Money Is unlocks the bank vaults for Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Unmissable. Complete the story mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Unmissable. Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Unmissable. Complete the story mission Child’s Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Unmissable. Complete the story mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Unmissable. Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Unmissable. Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton’s questline stays available after the credits, so there is no rush — finish it during the cleanup phase. His treasure sets also feed the 100% checklist (5 of 7).
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy’s questline stays available after the credits — finish it during the cleanup phase.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy’s questline is Lucia-only and stays available after the credits — finish it during the cleanup phase.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy’s questline stays available after the credits — finish it during the cleanup phase.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone’s questline is Jason-only and stays available after the credits — finish it during the cleanup phase.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret’s hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. The 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Deck objectives, so finish the whole questline.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off; fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast. Note: this method is guide-reported, not yet player-confirmed at launch.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.verification_note: Method is guide-reported (Output Lag, KeenGamer), not yet player-confirmed at launch.

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank (Rhino) and use it in combat. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops. Note: this method is guide-reported, not yet player-confirmed at launch.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.verification_note: Method is guide-reported (Output Lag, KeenGamer), not yet player-confirmed at launch.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Note: this method is guide-reported, not yet player-confirmed at launch.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.verification_note: Method is guide-reported (Output Lag, KeenGamer), not yet player-confirmed at launch.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind while you work on the other trophies. Note: this method is guide-reported, not yet player-confirmed at launch.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.verification_note: Method is guide-reported (Output Lag, KeenGamer), not yet player-confirmed at launch.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description — “Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.” — is the only hint, and it may pop while you play normally. This guide does not guess the method; check back once players confirm it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description — “Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.” — is the only hint. This guide does not guess the method; check back once players confirm it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description — “Second time's the charm.” — is the only hint. This guide does not guess the method; check back once players confirm it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description — “What the hell just happened?” — is the only hint. This guide does not guess the method; check back once players confirm it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description — “Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.” — is the only hint; the precise method is still being confirmed. This guide does not guess it; check back once players confirm it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
